messages:
mira: quick check — GA readiness gap review. which SLA / docs / monitoring / pricing items block a safe GA? need a minimal list we can commit to for Friday deploy.

sam: latency SLO language isn't final. we call out p95 today but contracts want p99 commitments.

leo: monitoring: dashboards exist but alerting for cross-region degradation is missing. I have a draft runbook but need time to wire alerts.

mira: list I'm thinking (must-have): SLA wording, billing examples in docs, oncall runbook, monitoring alerts, canary plan, pricing tier note for bursting. agree/disagree?

eva: docs: billing examples + rate-limit table are incomplete. I can cut a minimal PR with examples and one graph. aiming EOD.

anya: customer ask — two pilots need a commercial 99.9% uptime clause for Dedicated. that's separate from default hosted SLA. need path for exceptions.

kyle: pricing: we need clear language on burst capacity and overage billing. also document reserved capacity discounts. I can draft text but need final numbers from finance.

sam: SLA wording proposal: "Latency SLOs: p50 <200ms, p95 <350ms, p99 <700ms; Availability SLO: 99.5% (hosted), 99.9% opt-in for Dedicated w/ contract)." Thoughts?

leo: those look fine, but we should add an explicit degradation policy: automatic fallback to lower-cost model variant after 5m of degraded p95 in primary region. otherwise oncall gets paged.

mira: good call on fallback. add to runbook + docs. who owns fallback implementation?

sam: eng-runtime will own the fallback hooks. I'll open an RFC and a small task to wire policy + metric.

deploy-bot: CI: canary pipeline scheduled for 2026-03-26 22:00 UTC — will run smoke + perf tests.

leo: canary dashboard needs one more metric: multi-tenant token consumption by model. adding now.

mira: eva, can you include a short example snippet for billing showing burst vs reserved with numbers? we can mark numbers as TBD but show structure.

eva: yes — I'll add a "Billing examples" section with a small table and sample invoice line items. PR #542 soon.

anya: also add commercial exception playbook: timeline, decision owner, contract language stub. sales needs that to commit pilots.

kyle: I'll add pricing language draft to the playbook. need to sync with finance tomorrow.

mira: ok owners recap: SLA wording — sam, Monitoring alerts + dashboards + runbook — leo, Docs (billing/examples + billing snippet) — eva, Pricing playbook — kyle, Commercial exceptions — anya. fallback impl — sam. Canary run — deploy-bot scheduled.

sam: ETA: SLA + fallback RFC by EOD tomorrow.

leo: ETA: alerts + dashboard update by 24h.

eva: ETA: docs PR by EOD today (minimal).

kyle: pricing draft by tomorrow noon.

anya: I'll collect commercial pilot asks and draft exception flow by EOD.

mira: great — final decision + ship candidate on Friday if these land. syncing 4pm today for blockers. :eyes:

oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly oncall rotation starts 2026-03-27.

mira: thanks — will post a short owner checklist before the 4pm sync.

sam: ack.

leo: ack.

eva: ack.

anya: ack.

kyle: ack.
